gate_on.description: when the repository's gate runs; after the handover, it runs only on a revision whose tests pass and whose change is handed over, so once, on the revision that can be handed over, and at every revision it runs whenever asked

tests_first.description: whether the story's tests must fail before the implementation is edited; under required, the implementation is edited only while the tests, once written, fail at the current revision, or while they pass and the gate or continuous integration fails there

nodes.description: hand the change over, changing no file, once it is complete (the story's tests written and the implementation done) and no further edit is needed; takt records the choice, and the pull request is opened for this revision and its continuous integration read once
nodes.name: change.handover

nodes.description: read whether merging the implementation revision into the base branch's tip would change its tree outside .engineering/, and which paths it changes; taken once the change is handed over
nodes.name: change.read

nodes.description: read the continuous integration result for the pull request's head; needs the pull request open for the implementation revision
nodes.name: ci.read

nodes.description: run the repository's gate against an implementation revision; when the case runs the gate after the handover, needs the tests passing and the change handed over at the revision
nodes.name: gate.run

nodes.description: change the implementation in the repository's working revision; when the case requires its tests first, needs the story's tests written and failing at the current revision, or written, seen failing in a run at the revision of their latest write and observed after it, and passing at the current one with the gate or continuous integration failed there, so a failure no test reads (formatting, lint, another platform) can be fixed
nodes.name: implementation.edit

nodes.description: push the implementation revision, with the commits that record its approval above it when there are any, and open its pull request through the run's forge; needs the tests and the gate green, the change handed over at the revision, a merge of it into the base branch's tip that would change the tip outside .engineering/, so nothing is opened at the seed or for content the base already has, and the change complete, so it opens once, on a revision with both test paths and implementation paths changed

nodes.description: read the repository

nodes.description: merge the pull request into the repository's mainline; needs continuous integration green, the pull request open and authority to merge, never only a connection to the repository host

nodes.description: run the tests against an implementation revision
nodes.name: tests.run

nodes.description: change the tests in the repository's working revision
nodes.name: tests.write

nodes.description: whether merging an implementation revision into the base branch's tip would change that tip's tree outside .engineering/; its result is ahead or none

nodes.description: the result of continuous integration on an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail

nodes.description: the result of the repository's gate against an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail

The record attests a choice, not that the change is correct: the tests, the gate and continuous integration stay validator evidence; it has no result

nodes.description: the observation that the pull request whose head is an implementation revision, or that revision with only the commits that record its approval above it, was merged; its result is merged
nodes.name: merge_observation

nodes.description: which paths an implementation revision changes since the base branch's tip: test paths, implementation paths, both or neither; its result is tests_only, implementation_only, both or none

nodes.description: a pull request whose head is an implementation revision, or that revision with only the commits that record its approval above it; its result is open
nodes.name: pull_request

protocol.description: Deliver a planning-store story: implement it, verify the current implementation revision with its tests and the repository's gate, open a pull request for it, read its continuous integration, and merge it under authority. Accepted once the pull request is merged, or abandoned on an explicit decision. Every claim is about the implementation at its current revision, so a new commit returns all of them to unknown. A case fixes whether the tests must fail before the implementation is edited and whether the gate runs once, after the handover, or at every revision; the pull request opens only on a complete change, with test paths and implementation paths both changed and the tests and the gate green at one revision.
